title: LLMs Silently Correct African American English: Auditing and Mitigating Dialect Bias via Activation Steering

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating discriminative consistency via Conditional Dialect Group Invariance (cDGI) on sentiment classification tasks, and measuring generative preference using perplexity, log-probability bias scores, and multiple-choice forced continuation tasks comparing African American English (AAE) to Standard American English (SAE).
